post.caption: Mr T's gold chains were lost property. He was born Laurence Tureaud in Chicago in 1952, and at about eighteen he legally changed his name to Mr T. He worked as a nightclub bouncer, where customers lost or left behind gold chains, and he began wearing them. Putting on all his chains took close to an hour. In 1980 he won an NBC bouncer contest, and Sylvester Stallone noticed him and cast him in Rocky III. It opened in 1982.
